description.narrative: OPC applies a zero-tolerance policy on corruption. It is in this premise that capacity building is the central point of its efforts and initiatives with focus on strengthening accountability, participation and transparency among its partner-organisations and member-organisations. The project focuses on the conduct of regular and up-to-date anti-corruption seminars such as fraud awareness/detection and strengthening existing partner-organisations finance and administrative system. Part of OPC's anti-corruption policy is the inclusion of procurement and code of conduct steering documents that are regularly revisited and form part of all cooperation agreements. In addition to developing system and procedures to counter corruption, there is a specific focus on awareness raising with regards to nepotism, cronyism and power relations. OPC's work in this regard is centered around values and expected behaviour rather than a list of consequences related to specific transgressions.Project OrganisationsThis is a Palme Center project.Other Donors to the OrganisationNo other donors involved in this project.Project ObjectiveThe main objective of the project is to contribution in the fight against corruption by establishing, supporting and contributing to changes, more transparent and democratic organisational structures and behavioural patterns. OPC believes that the labour movement and civil society have a central role to play as role models, democractic schools and agents of change in the work against corruption.
